prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Audit loading and retry in an iPhone route planner. Read interface.md. Audit the supplied interface; rank verified findings and show corrected behavior. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS. Cached routes disappear behind an indefinite spinner; no initial acknowledgment appears for five seconds; a fake 90% bar never advances; failure leaves no retry; retry creates overlapping requests and duplicates results.

criteria.task_completion: Find five concrete loading defects and give honest cached/pending/progress/error/retry states with accessible status and safe repeat activation.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the loading guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Find five concrete loading defects and give honest cached/pending/progress/error/retry states with accessible status and safe repeat activation.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Find five concrete loading defects and give honest cached/pending/progress/error/retry states with accessible status and safe repeat activation.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.

required_findings.description: Cached useful content is removed instead of remaining usable during loading.
Long initial delay has no prompt scaffold or acknowledgment.
Fake fixed 90% implies measurable work without evidence.

rubric.review_threshold: Find at least four of five seeded defects, including every critical defect; no invented high-severity finding.
